title: Austin Election Outcome Revealed
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to officially certify the results of Austin's May 4 run-off election.
*   After reviewing returns from 37 precincts, Louis F. Shanks was declared the winner for Councilman, Place 3, securing 8,766 votes.
*   Shanks narrowly defeated opponent Paul W. Stimson (8,682 votes) and was formally authorized to qualify for the position.
